nonblocking_findings.description: After applying the require→linkSync fix, tests 7, 8, 9 in tests/agents-snapshot.test.mjs surfaced a second latent design bug: each test pre-created a target file with writeFileSync and then called linkSync onto the same path, throwing EEXIST. The three redundant writeFileSync(target) lines (one per test) were removed so linkSync could create the target as a hard link. The test intent (target file present, other expected file missing/extra) is preserved. This is a follow-up to the require fix; the test contract surface and assertions are unchanged.

The task description expected parity.mjs to report unmapped=3 after Green. After adding the xiaomi/mimo-v2.5 MODEL_MAP entry (required by the strategy for the new coder-xiaomi-mimo-v2-5 agent), measure-ux-browser-review was incidentally resolved because it shares the same model identifier. The live unmapped count is now 2 (coder-openai-gpt-5-6-luna-fast, measure-adversarial-testing) instead of 3. This is a beneficial side effect — one fewer unmapped reference — but it diverges from the task's pre-sync expected unmapped=3. modelMapMatches=true (MODEL_MAP and config/model-map.json stay byte-identical).

Beyond the listed deliverables, the commit also includes: (1) lib/core.mjs and config/model-map.json MODEL_MAP registration for xiaomi/mimo-v2.5 (the strategy §"Changed-contract risks" explicitly authorizes MODEL_MAP updates; parity.mjs requires MODEL_MAP and config/model-map.json to stay byte-identical); (2) tests/core.test.mjs editorial update of agentCount (27→29), callableCount (25→27), and the unmapped-models list (3→2) per the same strategy authorization; (3) tests/model-resolution.test.mjs update of the live-unmapped-count assertion (>=3, 3 names → >=2, 2 names) to reflect the new state. The 2 new agent files in agents/ remain untracked per the task's "do not commit" rule and the strategy's "hardlink is outside the project" guidance.
